dedupe_keys.name: udf of urban microclimate ansys fluent user defined functions for urban wind and pollution

description: This repository collects user defined functions for the commercial CFD software ANSYS Fluent that are commonly needed to simulate a realistic urban environment, with explanations in English and Chinese, produced by Jialei Shen. It includes functions for the inlet wind velocity profile, pollutant emission sources, trees and greening, and performance indices for judging urban ventilation, with tutorials on how to apply them in Fluent and a reading list of publications. Coverage: any urban geometry modelled in Fluent. Access: free on GitHub; many copies of the repository exist on GitHub and GitLab. Licence: GPL. Caveats: needs a licensed copy of ANSYS Fluent; last commit December 2022. Simulation uses are pedestrian wind comfort, pollutant exposure and heat mitigation by greening around buildings and in streets and squares. Related records: urbanMicroclimateFoam, an open-source alternative on OpenFOAM.
inputs: Urban geometry meshed in ANSYS Fluent
Pollutant sources and tree and greening zones
name: UDF of Urban Microclimate: ANSYS Fluent user defined functions for urban wind and pollution
outputs: Wind, pollutant dispersion and ventilation performance indices
